_comment: One CG hostile per galaxy and archetype. Styled with the galaxy flavour from tools/sprixen/manifest/bosses.json so grunts match their flagships; ref is that galaxy's flagship still. yaw (degrees about the up axis) turns each Tripo model nose-down for the render, set after looking at the preview.

kinds.SCOUT: a small, fast scout fighter: one slim pointed body with two short swept wings, lightweight and darting, a single engine glow at the tail
kinds.FIGHTER: a medium attack fighter: a compact armoured body with two forward weapon pods on short wings, twin engine glows at the tail
kinds.CRUISER: a heavy gun cruiser: a broad, thick armoured hull wider than it is long, a gun turret on top, four engine glows across the tail
